description: Returns the signed-in account's AnimatedWebs plan and today's usage (Pro prompt access or Prompt Pack credits, UI generations and Design AI requests used against the daily limits), links, the Design workspace URL, and on request the account's items. Use it to check whether a Pro prompt, generate_component or refine_component call will succeed, or to pick up earlier work; use get_pricing for plan prices and save_item to change saved items. include_items adds items: saved (templates, components and backgrounds saved with save_item or hearted on animatedwebs.com), unlocked (Pro templates already opened, so fetching their prompt again is free) and generated (prompt, model and date of each AI generation; the HTML itself is not stored). includeDesignConnect adds ready-to-paste setup for the separate AnimatedWebs Design MCP server; it contains a personal bearer token, so never write it to shared files. Counts are per UTC day. Read-only. Example: {"include_items":true,"items":"saved","items_limit":10}.

includeDesignConnect.description: true adds design.connect (Claude Code command, Cursor and VS Code config with a personal bearer token) and design.note. Default false keeps the token out of the reply.

include_items.description: true adds items (saved, unlocked and generated lists, newest first). Default false.

items.description: With include_items: which list to return. all (default), saved, unlocked or generated.

items_limit.description: With include_items: entries per list, 1 to 50 (default 20).

name: get_account

id.description: Template slug, component id or background slug

title.description: null when the item left the catalog

plan.description: Plan id, e.g. free, starter, pro or lifetime

title: Get my AnimatedWebs account
